description: Change how a market map looks, the same settings as Market Map Maker's style menu: theme (clean, shadcn, glass, dark, editorial, brand), columns (1-4), logo style (tile, square, wordmark, card), density (compact, comfortable, roomy), logo shape (rounded, circle, square), logo size (sm, md, lg) and greyscale logos. Applied instantly and free, no credits. Pass only what should change. Returns the same fields as get_market_map. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

logo.description: How each company shows: logo tile, square logo, wordmark, or a card with a one-line description.
